claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Fable and Claude Mythos 5.2 are the same underlying model, with Fable having cybersecurity and biology safeguards that let it be offered to all users, while Mythos access requires applying through verification programs.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable and Claude Mythos are the same underlying model. Fable has strong cybersecurity and biology safeguards to guard against misuse, which allows us to make it available to all users.
